scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and opened the bag.
Confirmed that shipping was €4.90 and the bag total was €17.90.
Went to checkout and entered Ada Lovelace’s contact and Lisbon address details.
Placed the order successfully; confirmation stated that order TS-6174 is in and that €17.90 was charged.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag and opened the bag page.
Confirmed the initial order summary showed €4.90 shipping and a €49.40 total.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once.
The updated order summary showed free shipping and a €51.00 total.

click: Adding Paper Filters to bag and opening the bag

click: Opening the bag from the Bag (2) link
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the bag page to finish loading
analyze: the total is €49.40.
assert: shipping is €4.90 and the total is €49.40.
click: Clicking Add one more Paper Filters next to quantity
analyze: the total is €51.00.
assert: shipping is now Free and the total is €51.00.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder, as requested.
Opened the bag and applied the lowercase promo code welcome10.
The discount was −€9.10, shipping was Free, and the final total was €81.90.

fix.summary: The bag stepper set each quantity to max(1, step) instead of max(1, current quantity + step), so the plus button reset the line to 1; it now applies the step to the current quantity and keeps the minimum of 1.
